classificationRule: These are retained build/tooling attempts and are not silently converted into provider product failures.

attempts.failure: The first shell inherited a Volta shim whose Node target was unavailable.
attempts.remediation: Used the active absolute Node installation with worktree-local XDG state.

attempts.failure: The second invocation accidentally doubled a relative path.
attempts.remediation: Resolved the exact secret-file path before the third read-only probe.

attempts.failure: A jq display expression was malformed.
attempts.remediation: Printed only the safe account-availability classification.

attempts.failure: A background launcher exited while the Firestore Java child remained alive.
attempts.remediation: Validated the exact listener PID, stopped it, and relaunched the suite in a retained foreground session.

attempts.failure: Firebase CLI automatically reserved Eventarc, Tasks, and Firestore UI websocket listeners not visible in the initial service list.
attempts.remediation: Inspected the installed firebase-tools source, preflighted adjacent ports, and pinned 4533, 4534, and 4535 explicitly.

attempts.failure: The scheduled function was ignored when the Pub/Sub emulator was absent.
attempts.remediation: Preflighted and pinned Pub/Sub to 4536, then relaunched and retained real scheduled-function initialization.

attempts.failure: Frozen dependency installs reported npm audit findings.
attempts.remediation: Retained both audit JSON receipts and did not mutate frozen versions with an automatic fix.

attempts.failure: The first Storage emulator list request lacked its owner bearer identity and returned HTTP 403.
attempts.remediation: Proved no mutation had begun, added the emulator owner identity, and reran exact-project cleanup successfully.

attempts.failure: The first PARTY-07 receipt lacked a simultaneous RSVP-total listener transition.
attempts.remediation: Kept it as partial evidence and reran only the missing fact on a separate fresh remediation namespace with its own baseline and cleanup.

attempts.failure: The first final build command was issued from repository root, which has no build script.
attempts.remediation: Reran from the arm work directory.

attempts.failure: The remediation project override referenced the Node process global directly in a browser-compiled module.
attempts.remediation: Read the optional environment through a typed globalThis projection; the production UI build then passed.
